scope.market_definition: The shipping containers market encompasses the production, distribution, and sale of containers used for transporting goods across various modes of transport. Key participants include manufacturers, distributors, wholesalers, and service providers operating globally to meet the demands of logistics and supply chain management.

This layer includes system integrators that provide solutions for container logistics.
